/>\r\n\u003Cspan id=\"docs-internal-guid-774a3de4-7fff-2375-b884-44af5bf90d12\">“I am honored and excited to have the privilege of being the head coach of the Weber State women’s soccer program,” He earned his bachelor’s degree in Business Administration from the University of Denver in 2009. \u003C/span>\u003Cbr />\r\n\u003Cbr />\r\n\u003Cspan id=\"docs-internal-guid-774a3de4-7fff-2375-b884-44af5bf90d12\">Following his college career, he was drafted in the 2009 MLS Superdraft by Chivas USA. \u003C/span>\u003Cbr />\r\n\u003Cbr />\r\n\u003Cspan id=\"docs-internal-guid-774a3de4-7fff-2375-b884-44af5bf90d12\">Christensen \u003C/span>played semi-professional soccer for several years before starting his coaching career. A four-year collegiate starter, she began her playing career at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV), where she led the team in goals and points as a freshman. She later transferred to Brigham Young University (BYU), earning Newcomer of the Year honors and serving as a two-year team captain. During her time at BYU, she helped lead the team to an NCAA #2 ranking and an Elite Eight finish in 2013, and was named the team’s Attacking Player of the Year. While serving as an assistant coach for the Utah Royals Reserves, she helped guide the team to a National Runner-Up finish in the Women’s Premier Soccer League (WPSL). The team also earned WPSL Staff of the Year and Franchise of the Year accolades, with both the Offensive and Defensive Players of the Year coming from the Utah Royals Reserve.
